research_question: Does the observed discrepancy persist when the controlling condition is varied within the admissible range?
hypothesis: The discrepancy is generated by the interaction between condition_A and condition_B rather than by measurement noise alone.
testable_prediction: If condition_A is varied while condition_B is held constant, the discrepancy should change systematically rather than remain statistically invariant.

method.description: Run a controlled comparison across several values of condition_A while preserving condition_B and recording the same observable.
procedure: Establish the baseline observation under condition_A0 and condition_B0.
Change condition_A to condition_A1 while preserving condition_B0.
Repeat the observation under condition_A2 while preserving condition_B0.
Compare the resulting observations with the baseline and prediction.
controls: Use the same measurement procedure for every trial.
Record raw observations separately from interpretation.
method.replication_plan: Repeat the full sequence independently before treating a systematic discrepancy as established.

expected_observation: The measured discrepancy changes monotonically or otherwise systematically with condition_A.
stop_condition: Stop when the predefined trial set is complete, a measurement validity failure occurs, or the observed data become sufficient to distinguish the stated prediction from its alternative under the defined method.

observations.description: Baseline discrepancy observed under condition_A0 and condition_B0.
Discrepancy decreased after changing condition_A while preserving condition_B0.
Discrepancy decreased again under a second value of condition_A while condition_B remained constant.

result: The observed discrepancy changed systematically with condition_A under the tested conditions.
interpretation: The observations are consistent with the proposed interaction, but the experiment does not yet exclude all alternative explanations.

uncertainty.description: The current experiment does not isolate every possible confounding variable.

limitations: Only a bounded range of condition_A was tested.
The present experiment does not independently eliminate all measurement-related explanations.
unresolved_difference: It remains unresolved whether the observed dependence is caused specifically by the proposed interaction or by another correlated factor.
next_question: Which additional condition can be varied to distinguish the proposed interaction from the principal alternative explanation?

continuation.handoff_reason: The experiment produced a structured partial confirmation and an unresolved difference requiring a discriminating follow-up experiment.
